title: The shepherd's son asks to join

plan.english: Lord, I have come to your house. Take me into your troop! Who are you, young man? Whose son are you? I am the son of a shepherd, and I carry a sharp spear. Have you seen battle? I have not seen battle. But I used to guard my father's livestock from the wolves. Then sit at my hearth tonight, and in the morning take up your spear.

title: The young man by the hearth

plan.english: Grandmother, why does the lord give so many gifts? He who gives nothing has no men. With gifts he holds his men. Has he given you gifts too? He gives me meat at the feasts.
